title: 10-Year TIPS auction (reopening)
source: TSY: treasury.gov tentative schedule — 1:00pm ET, formal announce ~6bd prior, checked 2026-08-18. RE-VERIFIED AT TWO TREASURY PRIMARIES 2026-09-09 by this event's own D-8 pulse, which upgrades the security identity from press/secondary to primary: treasurydirect.gov TA_WS/securities/upcoming (fetched direct, HTTP 200, its own updatedTimestamp 2026-09-04T14:31:27) and api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov upcoming_auctions (fetched direct, HTTP 200) both carry the same row — CUSIP 91282CRE3, security term 9-Year 10-Month, reopening Yes, auction 2026-09-17, issue 2026-09-30, offering amount still empty. So the reopened security is confirmed to be the July 2026 new issue at a primary source rather than at tipswatch.com, and the formal-announcement date is 2026-09-10 (fiscaldata announcemt_date), ONE DAY EARLIER than the ~2026-09-11 this event's ledger had carried since D-29; that release is already tracked as treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-09-10. TERMS NOW PUBLISHED, RE-VERIFIED AT THE PRIMARY 2026-09-15 by this event's D-2 pulse: the formal announcement landed on schedule and treasurydirect.gov xml/A_20260910_1.xml (fetched direct, HTTP 200, 3,341 bytes) carries OfferingAmount 19.000, MaxAward 6650000000 (the 35% rule), CurrentlyOutstanding 23321000000, ReOpeningIndicator Y, InterestRate 2.375, IndexRatioOnIssueDate 0.99985, single-price, competitive close 13:00 — corroborated field-for-field by TA_WS/securities/upcoming (offeringAmount 19000000000, updatedTimestamp 2026-09-10T11:01:29) and by api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov upcoming_auctions (offering_amt 19000000000). The $19B size is therefore no longer an estimate; it is TSY:-primary. The announcement also records SOMAIncluded N against SOMAHoldings 30411000000 — no Fed add-on, where the July 2026 new issue took a $2.322B one
notes: Real-yield supply the day after the FOMC; the breakeven reaction reads inflation expectations. Size $19B is PRIMARY-CONFIRMED as of the 2026-09-10 announcement (treasurydirect xml/A_20260910_1.xml + fiscaldata upcoming_auctions, both fetched 2026-09-15), replacing the estimate carried since 2026-08-19 — and with SOMAIncluded N the full $19B goes to private hands against $23.321B outstanding, roughly doubling the float on CUSIP 91282CRE3. The auction record independently matches the figure: the last three 10-Year TIPS reopenings all printed $19B (2025-09-18 and 2026-03-19 at 9-Year 10-Month, 2026-05-21 at 9-Year 8-Month; fiscaldata auctions_query, fetched 2026-09-09). The stop, when-issued yield and demand internals still do not exist. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-10y-tips-2026-09-17.md.
